description: Known security issues of one program, app or package (for example Chrome, Node.js, VS Code) or of a CVE id. Returns the matching products with incident id, title, severity, whether it is exploited in the wild, publication date, the verified fixed version and whether a fix procedure exists. The optional os narrows the fix availability to one system.
